briefing.headline: UWMC rockets 23.5% as small‑cap surge leads overnight move
briefing.summary: Mega‑cap tech stocks showed mixed, modest moves with three advancers and seven decliners, leaving the core average down about 0.12%. By contrast, smaller‑cap names were highly volatile – UWMC surged 23.5% while RGC, LKQ and CORT each plunged over 20%. The overall breadth was narrow, dominated by a few extreme outliers rather than a broad market swing.
